name: input-grid
description: Styled text input example for Fict

files.content:
import { Field, FieldGroup, FieldLabel } from '@/components/ui/field'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'

export default function InputGridExample() {
  return (
    <FieldGroup class="grid max-w-sm grid-cols-2">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel for="first-name">First Name</FieldLabel>
        <Input id="first-name" placeholder="Jordan" />
      </Field>
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel for="last-name">Last Name</FieldLabel>
        <Input id="last-name" placeholder="Lee" />
      </Field>
    </FieldGroup>
  )
}
